overview_description.description: Because is a high growth, direct-to-consumer personal care company focused on older adults. We started in 2017 with a simple idea - to make it easier for our families to get the products they needed. Today, we are on our way to becoming the #1 trusted brand for older adults, with the goal of helping millions lead vibrant, independent lives. We’ve raised over $40M in funding from top VC firms including Index Ventures and Khosla Ventures, and are grateful for the support for our customers, partners and investors.

about_short_description.short_description: Because is personal care direct-to-consumer company focused on meeting the needs of older adults.

product.name: Bladder Protection Products
product.description: Incontinence underwear, pads, guards, booster pads, bed protectors, and liners for managing bladder leaks across moderate, maximum, and overnight absorbency levels.

product.name: Personal Care Products
product.description: Skin, cleansing, and disposal products used alongside incontinence protection, including barrier cream, cleansing wipes, no-rinse spray, and disposal bags.

product.name: Supplements
product.description: Dietary supplements for bladder health, urinary tract support, probiotics, multivitamin needs, sleep support, and general wellness.

product.name: Daily Living Aids
product.description: Mobility and adaptive-living products, including rollator walkers, wheelchair accessories, adaptive footwear, and full-coverage washable gowns.

product.name: Incontinence Care Bundles
product.description: Preconfigured or customizable combinations of bladder protection and personal care products for recurring daily or overnight incontinence needs.

product.name: Because Subscribe & Save
product.description: A recurring-order service for automatically scheduled deliveries of Because products, with account controls for changing products, quantities, shipment dates, or frequency.
